record.original_question: (Well-known problem). Is Thompson’s group F automatic?

evidence.quote: (Well-known problem). Is Thompson’s group F automatic?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Thompson's group $F$ is the group with presentation
$$F = \langle x_0, x_1, x_2, \dots \mid x_n^{-1} x_k x_n = x_{k+1} \text{ for all } k > n \rangle,$$
equivalently the group of orientation-preserving piecewise-linear homeomorphisms of the unit interval $[0,1]$ whose breakpoints lie in the dyadic rationals $\mathbb{Z}[1/2]$ and whose slopes are integer powers of $2$.

A finitely generated group $G$ with finite generating set $A$ is called automatic if there exists a regular language $L \subseteq A^*$ surjecting onto $G$ (i.e. every element of $G$ has at least one representative in $L$) such that:
(i) for each $a \in A \cup \{1\}$, the set
$$\{(u, v) \in L \times L : u\, a =_G v\}$$
is recognized by a synchronous two-tape finite automaton (the "fellow traveller property" expressed via padded pairs of words).

Equivalently, there is a constant $K$ such that for any two words $u, v \in L$ with $u =_G v\,a$ for some $a \in A \cup \{1\}$, the corresponding paths in the Cayley graph $K$-fellow-travel.

Question: Is Thompson's group $F$ automatic?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether Thompson's group F is automatic appears to remain open as of recent literature. Related progress has been made: F has been shown to be 1-counter graph automatic (Elder–Taback, 2015) and autostackable (Cleary–Hermiller–Stein–Taback), but neither implies the standard automaticity property, and these works explicitly state that automaticity of F is unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Thompson's group F is 1-counter graph automatic
status_evidence.snippet: It is unknown whether Thompson's group F is automatic; we show that F admits a 1-counter graph automatic structure.
status_evidence.claim: Automaticity of F is stated as an open problem; a weaker structure (1-counter graph automatic) is established.

status_evidence.title: Autostackability of Thompson's group F
status_evidence.snippet: It is not known whether F is automatic or admits a finite or regular convergent rewriting system; we prove F is autostackable.
status_evidence.claim: Authors confirm the automaticity question for F remains open and prove the related autostackability property.
